## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      5 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 18 févr. 2026 - 22 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _claireac1234_, 18 août 2026, 1/5: "I’ve been a Forest user for many years now and have always enjoyed the cute trees and the incentive to put my phone down. The new UX that was just rolled out has so many pop-ups and distractions, and is flooding the app with monetization and pushes to pay a premium subscription for an app that I ALREADY PAID FOR. The value of Forest was in part the cost up front for an ad-free, push-free experience. The new UX makes this so much worse by making you go through multiple layers of pop-ups and questions to do a basic function. It has moved the obvious controls to unintuitive locations. Very disappointed to have an app that has been useful (and that I paid for!) ruined like this."
            2. _清辰戌_, 17 août 2026, 1/5: "The APP is too expensive!!!"
            3. _Noor_75_, 29 juil. 2026, 1/5: "Most of us bought the app to have it forever. Now they’re hitting us with the premium suscription, and now ADS???? yall became so greedy"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 9 juil. 2026 - 17 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _TDTW!_, 17 août 2026, 1/5: "The 2026 redesign is clearly meant to promote the paid subscription model and not for ergonomics. The post-session is now multiple screens showing among other unhelpful analytics the option to watch ads to boost reward. The new interface is buggy, slow, bloated, and often unresponsive. Useful features (e.g. adjusting focus time) are hidden behind unnecessary menus. The pay-to-unlock trees are background noise, but you can't ignore the constant nagging to watch ads or pay. The old interface was good precisely because it's minimalistic. I hope paid users can have the option to revert to the old interface. For other frustrated users: you can still use the interface if you turn on plant together. Apparently this feature will be removed once the new interface officially launches. I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."
            2. _w y_, 9 juil. 2026, 1/5: "paid for forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _suzicatherine_, 19 août 2026, 1/5: "Harder to use and regularly freezes since the recent update. The whole point is that I should not have to focus on what I’m doing - not think about the app & deal with it crashing. Counterproductive."
            2. _aritaaaa44849_, 17 août 2026, 1/5: "Latest update has been nothing short of a disappointment. It appears that any extra time of the focus time you set does not give extra points and I also seem to notice bugs when the time is complete. Why update an app that was perfect?"
